issues.description: ExcellenceLand is required to provide a public getter for the boolean attribute "excellentEnough" (per statement/UML). The solution instead defines `public boolean isExcellentEnough(boolean strictCheck)`, i.e., a method that looks like the getter but incorrectly takes an extra parameter not defined in the model. This contradicts the required parameterless getter signature and will mislead students and/or break signature-based tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace `public boolean isExcellentEnough(boolean strictCheck)` with a parameterless getter matching the attribute, e.g., `public boolean isExcellentEnough()` (or `public boolean getExcellentEnough()`), and update any tests accordingly.
